verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only resource-level versioning: pipelines are "versioned, reusable configurations", and published agent processors can be pinned as <id>@<version>. A public changelog records changes such as the Forge rename. There is no evidence of versioned API endpoints or any documented deprecation or sunset policy, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme, documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, machine-readable API spec, independent corroboration.
